title: API contracts and generated clients
summary: Original OpenAPI inventory/cache/chunk-upload contract, typed clients and a real loopback server; successful pagination, ETag 304 and idempotent completion fixtures plus Hurl, schema fuzzing and breaking-change checks.

profiles: Linux x86_64, Node 24.19.0 / TypeScript 5.9.3: generated client/typecheck and seven HTTP/transport tests passed, including pagination, ETag 304, concurrent upload offsets and exact/idempotent completion.
Linux x86_64, Node 24.19.0: Orval 8.41.0, Hey API 0.99.0 and TypeSpec 1.17.0 generation completed against the current schema/profile.

Linux x86_64, Hurl 8.0.1 verified upstream binary: all 22 local request-chain assertions passed. oasdiff v1.33.0 built with Go 1.27.2: unchanged baseline passed and removed GET /items failed as expected.
Linux x86_64, Python 3.12.14 / Schemathesis 4.30.1: seed 42 coverage/fuzzing selected eight operations; 284 generated cases passed, 14 skipped; stateful disabled and examples absent.
notes: Docker/Microcks acceptance remains unexecuted. Provision external tools from http/tool-versions.json deliberately; copying this pack never installs them.
Schemathesis warned that PATCH/complete mostly rejected generated requests requiring existing upload state. Node and Hurl separately exercise positive ordered flows.
Generated client/runtime trees are excluded. Regenerate deliberately and retain upstream notices. The fixture upload protocol is not a production tus server and clears state on restart.
Token acquisition, production authorization, retries, deployment and receiving-app generated-client compatibility remain host responsibilities.
